ORDER BY id

addr_type = 6
AND start_ip_binary <= INET6_ATON(#{resource}) ORDER BY start_ip_binary DESC LIMIT 500) AS t WHERE end_ip_binary >= INET6_ATON(#{resource}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

insert into cn_ip_asn_built_in (addr_type,addr_format,ip1,ip2,start_ip_binary, end_ip_binary,asn,organization,op_user,is_valid,op_time) values

update.foreach: update cn_ip_asn_built_in set addr_type = #{ip.addrType}, addr_format = #{ip.addrFormat}, ip1 = #{ip.ip1}, ip2 = #{ip.ip2}, start_ip_binary = INET6_ATON(#{ip.startIpBinary}), end_ip_binary = INET6_ATON(#{ip.endIpBinary}), asn = #{asn}, organization= #{organization}, op_time = #{ip.opTime}, op_user = #{ip.opUser}, is_valid = #{ip.isValid} where id = #{ip.asnId}
